items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: He had a brother, by the name of Lazar Hirsch, who, ended up in, in Amal, Louisiana.

ctx.x: So, it was right about that same time, then?

He had a brother, by the name of Lazar Hirsch, who, ended up in, in Amal, Louisiana. And they had, he had a grocery store, a general merchandise store, and later, they were the post office, in Amal, Louisiana. And his daughter, Julia Hirsch, was, later, made postmistress, after, after Lazar Hirsch died. And he had another, he had a son, Henry Hirsch, who went over to, Narco, that's right above, St. Rose. Of course, I mean, I don't know, what these towns are called now, Amal, and St. Rose, if they still, call…
What about, Charles Hirsch's business? Did he rent instruments, to musicians?
